plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Fine Arts, AA' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/fine-art-aa/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Fine Arts Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. Grid rows shown only as a footnote number with units (5, 6) do not name a specific course in the published schedule and are not defined as slot categories on this page — modeled as choice slots with the catalog's footnote number preserved in choice_note; see advisor (catalog footnote 3: see Fine Arts Faculty Adviser for the sequencing of fine arts requirements). Designed to transfer to the Bachelor of Fine Arts track at UNR, which has no foreign language requirement; students wishing to transfer to UNR's BFA Art should take ENV 101. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid.
